blocks.text: מֵרִאשׁוֹנָה. חֵטְא כָּל הַשָּׁנָה. דְּחוּת בְּקוֹל שׁוֹפָר: טֶבַע בְּרָכוֹת תֵּשַׁע. מוּל שׁוֹפָרוֹת תֵּשַׁע. טָהוֹר מֵהֶם יִשַּׁע. בְּקוֹל דַּת שׁוֹפָר: טֶנֶף צְחוּנֵי רֶשַׁע. בְּשׁוּבָם מִפֶּשַׁע. טְרִיָּתָם תְּשַׁעֲשַׁע. בְּקוֹל שֶׁוַע שׁוֹפָר: יִיטַב מִשּׁוֹר פָּר. וּמֵאֵיל הַמְּשֻׁפָּר. יוֹם הַמְּסֻפָּר. לְקוֹל חִדּוּשׁ שׁוֹפָר: יֵקֶשׁ יוּפָר. וְסוֹטֵן יְחֻפָּר. יֹשֶׁר לֵב יְשֻׁפָּר. בְּקוֹל שִׁפּוּר שׁוֹפָר: כְּעֵת הֵם תֹּקְעִים. גֵּיא מַבְקִיעִים. כְּרַכִּים מַשְׁקִיעִים. בְּקוֹל שְׁאוֹן שׁוֹפָר: כָּל הֲמוֹן מְרֵעִים. בְּחִיל מִתְרוֹעֲעִים. כַּאֲשֶׁר הֵם מַתְרִיעִים. קוֹל יָרִיעַ כַּשּׁוֹפָר: לְקוֹלוֹ כְּיֻקְשַׁב. יָבְעַת כָּל מוֹשָׁב. לְאֻמִּים בְּסַעַר יְנַשֵּׁב.
uncertainties: וְסוֹטֵן is printed with samekh and tet. The printed spelling is kept.
טֶנֶף (line 3): there is a small mark at the upper left of the final pe. It looks like a print speck, not a dagesh or rafe, and is not encoded.
יֵקֶשׁ (line 6): the mark under the yod may be segol rather than tsere. This line is already in human queue 445–454 (298 יחפר ישר ישפר), so it is not asked again.
יְנַשֵּׁב (line 10): the vowel under the shin is faint. Tsere is kept. This is the last weekday line, which is already in the human queue.
There are stray marks under יְחֻפָּר. They are not encoded.
The tiny first word could be misread as חַזָן. Humans have repeatedly confirmed it as אַם on earlier pages, so אַם is kept.

blocks.text: וְנִלְוָה לִי בַּשְּׁבִי. עִמּוֹ אָנֹכִי. אָז הִבְטִיחַנִי בְּקוֹל: יָרַד לְשִׁנְעָר. וְשָׂם כֵּס בְּעֵילָם. הִשְׁמִיעַ כַּאֲרִי. וּכְנָחָשׁ קוֹל: כִּלָּה מֶנִּי דּוֹב. כְּהִתְרַפָּה מִמְּלֶאכֶת. חַק בַּמִּכְתָּב. וַיַּעֲבֶר קֹל: כָּבַשׁ לִי. אַרְבָּעָה רָאשֵׁי נָמֵר. וְגַם אֲנִי בְּהוֹדָיוֹת סֶלָה. אַשְׁמִיעַ לוֹ קוֹל: לְחַיַּת קָנֶה. אָז מָכַר אֶרֶץ. מִי לִי בַשָּׁמַיִם. אָז הֵרִימָה קוֹל: לֵאלֹהֵי יִשְׁעִי. מִשִּׁנֵּי בַרְזֶל שִׁוַּעְתִּי. וּמֵרֶגֶל עַבְטִיט. הִצְרַחְתִּי בְּקוֹל: מִדַּת קִצִּי. לֹא הוֹדִיעַנִי. מָתַי בְּאַרְצִי. תּוֹר יַשְׁמִיעַ קוֹל: מִיּוֹדְעֵי סֵפֶר. חָתַם קִצִּי. לְבַל דַּעַת צוֹפַי. עֵת יִשְׂאוּ קוֹל: נָא הַבֵּט וּרְאֵה. עָנְיִי וּמְרוּדִי. אֵין לִי מַכִּיר. לְמִי אֶשָּׂא קוֹל: נֶצַח אֲקַוֶּה. כִּי לֹא יִפֹּל דָּבָר. מִמַּקְשִׁיבֵי. דְּמָמָה וָקוֹל: שׂוֹשׂ יָשִׂישׂ. לִבִּי בְּקִרְבִּי. בְּשָׁמְעִי דּוֹדִי דּוֹפֵק. עַל פְּתָחַי קוֹל:
uncertainties: קֹל after וַיַּעֲבֶר is clearly printed defective, with holam and no vav. The printed spelling is kept.
חַק: the mark is a plain horizontal stroke, so it is patah.
אַרְבָּעָה רָאשֵׁי and וְגַם אֲנִי are tightly set, but there is a word space in each.
לֵאלֹהֵי may use the alef-lamed ligature. It is encoded as a separate alef and lamed.

blocks.text: the whole year is banished by the sound of the Shofar. The form of the nine benedictions corresponds to the nine Shofar blasts; in His purity He allows them to entreat through the prescribed sound of the Shofar. Even those stained with evil, when they repent of transgression, Thou dost soothe their wound at the sound of the cry of the Shofar. Better than the sacrificial bullock and the splendid ram is the day appointed for the sound of renewal of the Shofar. The evil impulse is broken and the accuser disgraced and the upright heart refreshed at the sound of beauty of the Shofar. When once they blew the Shofar (before Jericho), they cleaved asunder the valley; they caused cities to sink through the tumult of the sound of the Shofar. All the multitude of the wicked will shake with trembling when they cry out aloud with a sound as piercing as the Shofar. When His voice is heard, every settlement is terrified, He blows away peoples in a hurricane

in captivity, ‘I am with him’ He assured me then with His voice. He went down to Shinear and set up His throne in Elam, where He made heard like a lion and like a serpent a voice. He saved me from the bear — when the work from the Sanctuary was disturbed — which had been inscribed in writing and proclaimed by a voice. He subdued for me the four heads of the leopard and in my gratitude I make heard to Him my voice. He then sold the land to the wild beast of the reeds, ‘who is above me in heaven?’ it boasted aloud with its voice. To the God of my salvation from the teeth of iron I cried and from before the trampling foot I shrieked with my voice. He has not made known to me the measure of my end, when in my land the turtle dove will make heard its voice. Even from scholars has He concealed my end, that my seers may not know the time when they will lift up their voice. Pray look and see my woe and my pain, there is no friend to me to whom I can raise my voice. For ever shall I hope that no word shall be omitted from those who listen for a still small voice. In my midst my heart rejoices when I hear my Beloved sounding on my doors with His voice.
uncertainties: 'Shinear' is the printed spelling and is kept.
